description: Search Outdoors (theoutdoorsapp.com) for U.S. hiking trails, parks, campgrounds, and Outdoors Journal articles (route guides, 14er and thru-hike guides). Accepts plain names ("Half Dome") or natural requests ("best hikes in Colorado", "camping near Yosemite", "easy hikes in NC", "national parks in Utah") — a named U.S. state, place type and difficulty are applied as filters. Returns a list of results whose ids can be passed to the fetch tool for the full record.
name: search
